Our cybersecurity services deliver comprehensive protection powered by cutting-edge AI across your entire business lifecycle. We offer strategic consulting to help you define your security posture, provide intelligent solution integration to implement robust defenses, and deliver continuous AI-powered managed security services through our global network. This ensures unparalleled protection, empowering you to navigate the evolving threat landscape with unwavering confidence.
With our cybersecurity services, your business can:
Operate with confidence, knowing your critical assets are shielded by a proactive and adaptive security posture.
Detect and neutralize threats before they impact your operations, ensuring business continuity and minimizing potential disruptions.
Keep data secure and compliant, fostering trust with your customers and partners in an increasingly interconnected world.
Rely on a resilient infrastructure that seamlessly recovers from any challenge, so you can focus on innovation and growth without fear of cyber setbacks.

Build resilient cyber defenses
For over 25 years, we have been at the forefront of cybersecurity. We have protected businesses through every wave of digital transformation with our deep industry knowledge, battle-tested frameworks, and real-world insights. Our comprehensive suite of cybersecurity services is built around seven core pillars to address your diverse security needs:
Security advisory
Develop a robust security strategy aligned with your business goals. Our experts provide guidance on risk management, compliance, security architecture, and data protection.
Learn more
Security testing
Proactively identify vulnerabilities in your systems and applications through comprehensive testing services, including penetration testing and vulnerability management.
Learn more
Hybrid cloud security
Secure your cloud journey with our specialized services for platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP, protecting your data and infrastructure around the clock.
Learn more
Identity security
Control and secure access to your critical resources with our identity and access management, including SSO, privileged access management, and identity governance.
Learn more
OT security
Safeguard your industrial control systems and operational technology environments from evolving cyber threats, ensuring the safety and reliability of your operations.
Learn more
Threat detection, investigation and response
Enhance your cybersecurity with services that offer proactive protection, real-time threat detection, in-depth investigations, and rapid response to mitigate potential threats.
Learn more
Emerging cyber
Stay ahead of future threats by leveraging our expertise in post-quantum cryptography, privacy-enhancing computation, security for AI, and more.
Learn more
Why choose us for your cybersecurity needs?
Legacy of trust
As a recognized global leader and the European number one, you can access our deep, broad cybersecurity expertise and rely on our proven track record as well as 24/7/365 coverage from our globally distributed SOCs.
Holistic global defense
Protect your organization from end to end with our suite of 100+ tailored cybersecurity services, delivered across 30+ jurisdictions with proactive monitoring for new regulations to meet your specific needs.
Proactive and globally informed approach
We help minimize your risk with proactive security testing – we’ve tested 250000+ systems in the last decade – along with global threat intelligence from our wide SOC network and partners, and AI-enhanced threat intel platforms.
Cutting-edge, innovative technologies
Future-proof your cybersecurity with our global investments in emerging technologies, research from our scientific community (with hundreds of patents), and our cybersecurity tech radar, which empowers you to make informed security decisions.
Decades of strong client relationships
For over 20 years, we’ve supported more than 2000 clients worldwide. Our seamless cybersecurity for the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games demonstrates our commitment to building long-term relationships that deliver tangible results.
Deep industry-specific expertise
We offer tailored security solutions, recognized by leading analysts, delivered by teams with a deep understanding across various industries. Our specialized sector practices ensure we address your unique requirements, no matter where you are.
